page.layout: One page of running text in two paragraphs, with the running head at the top and the page number at the head. Below the text, the closing words "FINIS LOGICÆ." and a woodcut of a flower basket.

main_text.p: vel doctrinæ, vel naturæ: Ordo Doctrinæ à facilioribus, magis necessa-rijs, & ijs quæ inseruiunt ad alia intelligenda progreditur: Ordo verò naturæ à prioribus naturâ ad posteriora naturâ procedit; atque adeo à partibus ad totum, ab universalibus ad particularia, ab imperfectioribus, ad perfectiora progreditur.

Methodus duplex ponitur à Philosophis, scilicet synthetica seu compositiua, & Analytica seu resolutiua: Synthetica progreditur à partibus ad totum, à simplicibus ad composita, ab universalibus ad particularia, à principijs & causis ad principiata & causata, & ideo seruat ordinem naturæ; talique Methodo traduntur communiter disciplinæ speculatiuæ: Analytica è contra progreditur à toto ad partes, & à fine ad media, talique Methodo tradi solent disciplinæ practicæ.

page.notes: Woodcut below the closing words: a flower basket or vase with flowers and leaves, not text. Faint watermark-style print at the lower right corner, which is a digitiser's mark and left out. Small mark before "Ordo Doctrinæ" in the scan may be a stray stroke rather than a quotation mark; read as "Ordo Doctrinæ". Final "ij" forms in "necessa-rijs" and "ijs" are printed as shown. "vel" in the first line is partly damaged in the scan and read as "vel".
